title: DiComponentContribution
description: A dependency-injection-managed component: Spring `@Component`/`@Service`/`@Repository`/`@Bean`, JSR-330 `@Inject` target, NestJS provider, Symfony service, Guice binding, etc. Pattern-C universal slot (§8bis Rule 2). Producers (techno-specific KSs, Rule 1): `SpringScanKS` today; future `MicronautScanKS`, `QuarkusScanKS`, `NestJsScanKS`, etc.

componentSymbol.description: SCIP symbol id of the class / function whose instance is DI-managed. Pattern-C back-pointer (§8bis Rule 2).

scope.description: DI lifecycle scope, normalized to a universal vocabulary.

qualifier.description: Optional name/qualifier under which the component is registered.

factoryMethodSymbol.description: SCIP symbol id of the `@Bean`-style factory method when the component is produced by one (rather than scanned).

exposedTypes.description: SCIP symbol ids of the interfaces / supertypes the DI container exposes this component as.

nativeAttributes.description: Pattern-C escape hatch (§8bis Rule 2). Framework-specific facts (e.g. Spring `@Profile`, `@Conditional*`, NestJS module scope, Quarkus `@Startup`).
